note: Trigger for meas-background.yml (9.7 campaign; 9.10's `upgrade`, D36–D37, `dkms`, D46–D50, `tracker`, D60–D68, `mnist`, D82–D84, `handbrake`, D11, D91–D95, `kdenlive`, D10, D101–D104, and `dejadup`, D8, D112–D118). Dispatch is unavailable off the default branch, so a push that changes this file starts the runs it names. Set apps to [] to skip; repeats is one list for every program or a map program -> list. mode: dry | probe | full | diag | shapediag (SteamCMD only, neither is a repeat; shapediag is D24's queue-discipline test). work_root: auto | / | /mnt. steam_update_from: the branch staged before steam-update-shaped (empty: no update phase); steam_update_to: app_update's -beta argument back to the public build. steam_dry_app: smallest | an app id. archiver_set: 10gb | 1gb. dejadup_set: 100mb | 10gb, the dejadup job's set in dry mode (full mode always 10gb). steam_diag_setting: diag mode's setting under test (empty: one content server forced).
